title: A Space owner connects their own domain from the Page panel and sees the DNS records to set, instead of needing an engineer

source.ref: PROG-E10 phase 3 of the white label sites build (ADR-1708), owner ask 2026-10-06: do all the domain setup for danieltyack.com through the app

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 by owner ask ("I want to do all the domain stuff for danieltyack.com through the app on Frequency. Make sure all the admin fields and instructions are in place for the DNS change"). THE CONSEQUENCE: binding a Space's domain meant a SQL update on spaces.domain, adding the domain in the Vercel dashboard, and finding the DNS records by hand. THE FIX: a Your domain section on the Space's Page panel (manage/layout). Connect parses what the owner types (lib/sites/domain.ts), checks the custom_domain plan gate, stores it in spaces.domain (unique; a taken domain is refused), and adds the domain plus www (308 to the apex) to the Frequency Vercel project (lib/sites/vercel-domains.ts). The section then shows three checks (connected to hosting, ownership confirmed, DNS points to the website) and the exact records to set at the registrar (A @, CNAME www, plus any TXT ownership record Vercel asks for, using Vercel's own recommendations), with plain instructions. Check again re-verifies; Remove detaches the domain and clears the column. CONFIG: VERCEL_API_TOKEN, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID, VERCEL_TEAM_ID (.env.example). Without them the section still saves the domain and shows the standard records, and says hosting is not connected.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const act=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/layout/actions.ts');const page=r('components/sites/space-website-feature.tsx');const board=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/manage-board.tsx');const v=r('lib/sites/vercel-domains.ts');const miss=[];if(!/export async function connectSiteDomain/.test(act)||!/export async function checkSiteDomain/.test(act)||!/export async function removeSiteDomain/.test(act))miss.push('there are no connect, check and remove actions');if(!/<SiteDomainPanel/.test(page)||!/<SpaceWebsiteFeature/.test(board))miss.push('Profile and Settings has no domain section');if(!/\/v10\/projects\//.test(v)||!/\/config/.test(v))miss.push('nothing adds the domain to hosting or reads its DNS records');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-743: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Measures the consequence at its seams: the owner-facing connect, check and remove actions exist, the Page panel renders the domain section, and the domain client both attaches the domain to the Vercel project and reads its DNS config. Failed on main before this change (no domain UI, no Vercel client). Parsing and the record list are unit-tested in lib/sites/domain.test.ts. RE-POINTED 2026-10-06 (#3212, owner ask): the domain section moved from the Page panel to the Your website card on Profile & Settings, rendered by the manage board.
